description: Stereo voltage-controlled amplifier built on the Fundamental VCA, with one level control and one CV jack acting on both channels

params.text: Sets the gain applied to both channels, 0 to 1
Switches the CV response between exponential and linear; on exponential the control voltage is raised to the fourth power

inputs.text: Scales the gain, 0V for silence and 10V for the full setting of the level slider; voltages outside that are clamped

outputs.text: The left audio input at the set gain
The right audio input at the set gain

notes: the channel count of every output is the largest of the two audio inputs and the CV input, so a polyphonic CV alone will make the outputs polyphonic
with no cable in the CV jack the level control acts on its own; the CV only multiplies it when something is patched

inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the level slider alone; a negative voltage does nothing here.
